description: Add a feature end to end: read-only plan, the person approves the plan, implement, verify by the test process with a bounded repair loop, independent review. Реализует функцию: план -> твоё одобрение -> код -> тесты -> ревью.

nodes.instruction:
Feature request: {{task}}
Study the code and write a concrete implementation plan: files to change, the order, tests to add, risks. Do NOT modify anything. Answer with the JSON object: plan=<the plan as text>.
Run the tests; the exit code decides.
